description: What a buy or sell would do now, without building it: route (POPULAR curve, SuiPump curve or DEX aggregator), amount paid, expected and minimum received, fees, price and price impact.

amount.description: Buy: SUI to spend. Sell: tokens to sell. Whole units as a decimal, e.g. "1.5".

percent.description: Sell only: a share of `sender`'s balance instead of amount.

sender.description: Optional: the wallet's fee tier and, for percent, its balance.

token.description: The token's POPULAR id (0x…, from search_tokens) or its coin type (0x…::module::NAME).

name: quote_trade
title: Quote a trade
